name: When are hardware and functional adjustments typically performed during a construction project?

mainEntity.name: When are hardware and functional adjustments typically performed during a construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: These adjustments are usually performed towards the final stages of a construction project, often during the punch list phase or after major installations are complete. It's the period when the builder ensures all elements are working as intended before client handover. Sometimes minor adjustments may be needed after initial occupancy due to settling or usage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Adjustments are typically done in the final stages of construction, during the punch list phase, or after major installations.
